**Yes – you can file a noise complaint in Atlanta.** The City of Atlanta’s **Department of Public Safety (Atlanta Police Department)** handles most noise‑related complaints, and the city also has a dedicated online portal for reporting violations. --- ### How to File a Noise Complaint | Method | What to Do | Contact / Link | |--------|------------|----------------| | **Phone** | Call the Atlanta Police Department’s non‑emergency line at **(404) 656‑4000** and request to report a noise violation. | (404) 656‑4000 | | **Online** | Visit the city’s 311 portal: → “Report a Problem” → select “Noise” or “Public Nuisance.” Fill out the required fields (location, description, time, etc.). | | | **Email** | Send a detailed description to the city’s public safety email: **police@atlantaga.gov** (or the specific email listed under the “Noise Ordinance” page). | police@atlantaga.gov | | **In‑person** | Go to the nearest police precinct or the City Hall’s Public Safety Office. Bring any evidence (photos, videos, timestamps). | City Hall, 55 Marietta Street NE, Atlanta, GA 30303 | > **Tip:** If the noise originates from a commercial property (e.g., a bar, construction site), you may also want to contact the **City of Atlanta Code Enforcement** at (404) 656‑4000 or via their online portal. --- ### Key Points About Atlanta’s Noise Ordinance | Detail | Information | |--------|-------------| | **Quiet Hours** | • Weekdays: 10 p.m. – 7 a.m.
• Saturdays & Sundays: 11 p.m. – 8 a.m. | | **Typical Violations** | • Loud music after quiet hours
• Construction noise outside permitted hours
• Excessive barking or other animal noises | | **Penalties** | First offense: up to $500 fine; repeat offenders may face higher fines or civil penalties. | | **Reporting Timeframe** | Report as soon as possible—ideally within 24–48 hours of the disturbance. | > **Reference:** Full text of the noise ordinance can be found here: --- ### After You File 1. **Confirmation** – You’ll receive a confirmation number (via email or phone). Keep this for follow‑up. 2. **Investigation** – Officers will assess the situation; they may issue a warning, a citation, or refer the case to the city’s code enforcement office. 3. **Follow‑up** – If the problem persists, you can call back with your confirmation number and request an update. --- #### Quick Summary - **Yes**, you can file a noise complaint in Atlanta. - Use the **311 portal**, call **(404) 656‑4000**, or email **police@atlantaga.gov**. - For commercial or building‑related issues, also reach out to **Code Enforcement**. - Refer to the city’s noise ordinance for specific rules and penalties. Feel free to let me know if you’d like more details on how to prepare your complaint (e.g., what information to gather) or if you’re dealing with a particular type of noise (construction, music, pets, etc.).
